title: Billie Holiday leaves in early 1938; Basie's 1938 changes
summary: Jones says Billie Holiday stayed nearly a year, leaving after the Chick Webb battle, and the band replaces its trumpets and trombones.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Do you remember how long she stayed with the band, until what year?
She was with the band nearly a year.
That would take up to what year?
She started in '37 and the first of '38 after
we did the Chick Webb thing and we were going downtown to play, she departed.
...What happened with the band, with you, and what did the band do from '38, 39 -
Little Bobby Moore, we was going through things with Little Bobby Moore and when he got his teeth fixed - I mean things happened and there was really nothing happened with the Basie band.
Harry Edison took Bobby Moore's place in 1937.

'38, as you say. So now we'll start with '38 with you now. What was it like? You've got Shad Collins coming in now and Harry Edison coming in now. You've got Dickie Wells and Benny Morton now to replace Ed Durham.
